description: Deep ensemble (improve of r05 = r00_draft2_v4tfshape; ONE change: M = n_members independently initialised copies of the incumbent V4-exact relational transformer, trained side by side in one module and averaged). Member = the incumbent unchanged: 1 global token embedded from (h, p) and 4 resonator tokens embedded by ONE shared GELU MLP from ellipse shape-tensor invariants s = rx+ry, u, v = (rx-ry)cos/sin 2theta, |d| = sqrt(u^2 + v^2 + eps^2), u/|d|, v/|d|, plus h, p; n_layers pre-LN transformer blocks (d_model, 8 heads, GELU FFN 4x, dropout) with learned per-head attention-logit biases per tok
model_repr:
EnsembleV4RelTransformer(
  (res1): BLinear()
  (res2): BLinear()
  (glob1): BLinear()
  (glob2): BLinear()
  (blocks): ModuleList(
    (0-3): 4 x BBlock(
      (n1): BLayerNorm()
      (att): BRelAttention(
        (qkv): BLinear()
        (proj): BLinear()
      )
      (n2): BLayerNorm()
      (ff1): BLinear()
      (ff2): BLinear()
      (drop): Dropout(p=0.02, inplace=False)
    )
  )
  (norm): BLayerNorm()
  (head1): BLinear()
  (head2): BLinear()
  (head3): BLinear()
  (head_drop): Dropout(p=0.02, inplace=False)
)
